title: The BuddyForms WordPress plugin before 2.10.3 does not check that the requester is allowed to manage a form before…
description: A vulnerability in the BuddyForms WordPress plugin versions prior to 2.10.3 allows unauthenticated users to export and download the configuration of any form without proper authorization checks. This exposure includes sensitive data such as notification recipient email addresses and reCAPTCHA secret keys that are not publicly visible on the form.
